pageDescription: Manage cycle definitions and assign protocol templates.
nameHelp: Internal name for this cycle configuration.
resetHelp: A new cycle starts after this date — e.g. July 31 → starts August 1.
deleteConfirm: Delete cycle configuration? Only possible while no template is assigned.
resetReassignHelp: By default every event belongs to the cycle its date falls into. A new cycle picks up all existing events this way; if the reset date changes, these default assignments move along. Manually set assignments stay unchanged.
deleteInUse: This cycle is still used by a template or a submission and cannot be deleted.
